sophie_infra: Heads up — onboarding (AcmeHealth) needs 8x A100 GPUs in eu-west4 (GCP) and 4x p4d in eu-west-1 (AWS) for a private deployment. Also need +40 NAT public IPs and ENI quota bump. I opened support cases with both providers. Can folks coordinate? Target reservation date: 2026-03-28.

gcp_support_bot: GCP case 20045123 created: initial review started. Request: project-level GPU quota increase and external IP quota. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/case/20045123

ken_ops: Copy. Sophie — any constraints on preemptible/spot vs on-demand? Ashley — can finance weigh in on cost/commit tradeoffs?

ashley_fin: Quick numbers (rough): 8x A100 (on-demand) ~ $3.20/hr each -> ~ $25k/mo if run 24/7. 1-year committed use would drop ~30%. For PoC we can do preemptible (up to ~70% cheaper) but risk eviction; not good for long-lived KV-backed sessions. I'll run a detailed sheet and share link later today.

anya_sre: What nodepool layout are we thinking? Suggesting 2 nodepools: small dev (1 GPU) and prod (4 GPUs). Example k8s spec I'm proposing: ```apiVersion: v1
kind: NodePool
name: a100-4
replicas: 2
resources:
  limits:
    nvidia.com/gpu: 4```

matt_reliability: AWS case created as well: 30099877. Support asked for account-level justification and expected vCPU/ENI counts before they approve p4d capacity. I filled in initial form, but they need numbers and concurrency profile.

aws_support_bot: AWS case 30099877: Support ticket logged. Please provide expected vCPU, ENI, and burst/steady-state targets. Next action: customer reply within 24h to avoid delay.

sophie_infra: Attaching the numbers we plan to submit: GPU nodes: GCP 8x A100 (40GB) arranged as 2 nodes x 4g; AWS 4x p4d (for redundancy). ENIs: request +40. External IPs/NAT: +40. Also request increased spot capacity for burst.

sophie_infra: Command used to capture current quotas for GCP: ```gcloud compute regions describe eu-west4 --project=redwood-infra | jq .quotas```

ken_ops: I pinged our GCP rep (liam.g@google.com) and flagged as urgent. He replied asking for sustained throughput estimates (tokens/sec) and whether we can accept autoscaling ramp vs immediate capacity. Sophie — can you paste perf baselines?

sophie_infra: Baseline perf: ~1500 tokens/sec per A100 for 2k context using our optimized runtime; p4d roughly comparable per-GPU. For expected concurrency (~40 concurrent sessions) we need the quoted capacity. Will upload perf doc in a mo.

gcp_support_bot: Update on case 20045123: support engineer assigned (liam.g@google.com). Quota increase review scheduled for 2026-03-25. They requested billing verification and project owners to confirm traffic patterns.

ashley_fin: Billing verified for the project — I've confirmed payment method and org billing account. I'm on the call with GCP billing tomorrow 09:30 PT to accelerate. Cost worksheet: https://redwood.internal/costsheets/acme_onboarding (internal).

anya_sre: OK I'm drafting the rollout plan: canary with 2 A100 nodes in eu-west4-staging -> smoke tests -> scale to 2x4-gpu nodes in prod. Will post the kube manifests and the maintenance window (probably 03/27 22:00 UTC).

matt_reliability: For AWS, support asked for a dedicated capacity justification if we want p4d guaranteed. If we can't get dedicated, we should fallback to instance pools across AZs and use fallback policy. Also note we need to request ENIs per network interface per instance class — I'll add exact counts to the support reply.

sophie_infra: Thanks all. Keeping this thread as canonical. If anyone escalates externally, please cc @ken_ops and include both case numbers (GCP 20045123 / AWS 30099877). Ping here for updates. :thumbsup:

ken_ops: I'll follow up with both reps after Ashley's cost confirmation. If GCP can't commit by 03/25 we may shift capacity to eu-west1 temporarily.

gcp_support_bot: Case 20045123 note added by liam.g: "Request looks good; pending billing verification and final quota approval. ETA update 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC."

aws_support_bot: Case 30099877 status: "Awaiting customer reply with vCPU/ENI numbers. Support tier: Business. Escalation hold available on request."

ashley_fin: Shared the detailed cost sheet and a 3-month run-rate estimate in the product onboarding drive. I'll join the billing call.

anya_sre: Adding task list: 1) finalize kube manifests, 2) update infra-as-code for nodepool sizes, 3) schedule canary window, 4) prepare rollback playbook. I'll drop PRs by EOD.

sophie_infra: Perfect. I'll send the perf doc and the formal justification reply to both support cases now. Will update thread after replies come in.
